hero.subtitle: Bringing compassionate, 24-hour medical care and experienced doctors right to our local communities in Veeracholan, Perunali, Vembar, Narikkudi, Potakavayal, and Nainarkovil.

about.title: A Community Clinic Built on Trust and Care
about.para1: Amritha Clinic was founded with a simple, genuine promise: no patient should have to travel hours to the city just to receive trustworthy, attentive medical attention. What began as a neighborhood practice has grown into a close-knit network of strategic branches across Tamil Nadu.
about.para2: We combine modern clinical diagnostics, 24×7 inpatient observation, and pharmacy care with the warmth of a family physician who truly listens. From everyday wellness checkups to urgent midnight care, our doors are open with doctors who know our patients by name.
about.highlight2: Affordable treatment plans tailored for local families

services.title: Medical Services for Every Family Member
services.subtitle: From everyday consultations to round-the-clock emergency support, our clinics are fully equipped for your healthcare needs.

generalMedicine.title: General & Family Medicine
generalMedicine.desc: Thorough diagnosis and compassionate treatment for fevers, seasonal infections, hypertension, diabetes, and ongoing family health.

emergencyCare.title: 24×7 Emergency & Trauma
emergencyCare.desc: Round-the-clock rapid medical response, wound dressing, acute stabilization, and continuous patient observation at Veeracholan, Perunali & Vembar.

maternalCare.title: Maternal & Child Healthcare
maternalCare.desc: Gentle prenatal and postnatal consultations, child immunizations, pediatric care, and nutritional advice for mothers.

pharmacy.title: In-House Pharmacy & Lab
pharmacy.desc: Instant access to authentic prescription medications, daily diabetic monitoring, rapid blood tests, and diagnostic screenings.

chronicCare.title: Chronic Disease Care
chronicCare.desc: Personalized management programs for blood pressure, thyroid disorders, asthma, cholesterol, and preventive lifestyle guidance.

minorSurgery.title: Minor Procedures & Day Care
minorSurgery.desc: Sterile outpatient procedures, stitch removal, burn treatments, IV hydration, nebulization, and ECG monitoring.
